# ZenML

> > ZenML is an open-source MLOps framework for building production-ready machine learning pipelines with integrations across cloud platforms, orchestrators, and experiment tracking tools.

ZenML provides infrastructure for ML teams to standardize workflows from experimentation to production deployment. The platform offers extensive integrations with tools like Vertex AI, BentoML, Kubernetes, and experiment trackers, while maintaining a comprehensive LLMOps Database documenting real-world production deployments.

## Key Topics

- MLOps pipelines and orchestration
- LLMOps and production LLM deployment
- Experiment tracking (WandB, Neptune AI, Comet)
- Model deployment (BentoML, AWS SageMaker)
- Cloud integrations (GCP Vertex AI, Azure, Kubernetes)
- AI agents and multi-agent systems
- LangGraph and agent frameworks
- Pipeline automation and standardization
- Production ML best practices
- OpenAI and Anthropic integrations
- Lightning AI Studios
- Artifact stores (Azure Blob Storage)
- Framework comparisons (CrewAI, Agno)
- LLM evaluation and production readiness
- MCP server and MLOps conversations

## LLMOps and Production AI

- [LLMOps Lessons Learned: Navigating the Wild West of Production LLMs](https://www.zenml.io/blog/llmops-lessons-learned-navigating-the-wild-west-of-production-llms): Insights from 300+ real-world LLM deployments in ZenML's LLMOps Database
- [LLM Agents in Production: Architectures, Challenges, and Best Practices](https://www.zenml.io/blog/llm-agents-in-production-architectures-challenges-and-best-practices): Production LLM agent architectures with real-world case studies and challenges
- [The Evaluation Playbook: Making LLMs Production-Ready](https://www.zenml.io/blog/the-evaluation-playbook-making-llms-production-ready): Real-world lessons in LLM evaluation with case studies from industry leaders
- [The Hidden Cost of ML Chaos: Why Your Data Team Needs MLOps Standards Now](https://www.zenml.io/blog/why-your-data-team-needs-mlops-standards-now): Analysis of hidden costs from lack of MLOps standardization in data teams
- [ZenML's MCP Server Supports DXT: Making MLOps Conversations Frictionless](https://www.zenml.io/blog/zenmls-mcp-server-supports-dxt-making-mlops-conversations-frictionless): DXT-packaged MCP server enables natural language MLOps workflow interactions

## AI Agent Frameworks and Comparisons

- [We Tried and Tested 7 CrewAI Alternatives to Build Automated AI Workflows](https://www.zenml.io/blog/crewai-alternatives): Comparison of 7 CrewAI alternatives for building automated AI workflows
- [Agno vs LangGraph: Best Framework to Build Multi-Agent Systems](https://www.zenml.io/blog/agno-vs-langgraph): Framework comparison: Agno vs LangGraph for multi-agent system development
- [Integrate OpenAI Agents SDK with ZenML](https://www.zenml.io/integrations/openai-agents-sdk): Integration guide for OpenAI Agents SDK with ZenML agent orchestration
